summary:
Disputed: the crash happens inside the crash-report handler
(sigsegvHandler, debug.c) after redis has already crashed, so it is not a
denial of service. The upstream change 0bf90d94 (redis 6.2.8/7.0.6) is an
ancestor of the 8.0.2 tag and is present in this source
(getAndSetMcontextEip). Debian rates it unimportant and never recorded a
fixed version, which is why every suite still shows as vulnerable.
